notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines – Vietnam: Technical Playtest Begins Now!
notes.content:
We're kicking off our technical playtest today, May 23 – a bit differently than planned.

[previewyoutube=OeL0vvx32zQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Due to a pending approval for the dedicated Playtest App, we've decided to launch the Steam Demo version early instead. This version will be updated continuously based on your feedback and will remain available for about one month, including during Steam Next Fest.

[b]What's in the demo?[/b]
You'll experience a slice of a campaign mission with multiple replayable routes. Each run takes between 30 and 60 minutes. Weapons can be ranked up, and attachments unlocked.

[b]What we're looking for:[/b]
[list]
[*] How well does it run on your system?
[*] Did you encounter any critical bugs or crashes?
[*] Are there design elements you’d like to see improved?
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/4b37ec36792022fa2d73018e6eaae9840337a769.jpg[/img]

⚠️ [b]This is a work-in-progress. Expect bugs, placeholder content, and unfinished systems. Your input will directly shape how the game evolves.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/09c9c962a47625315bd933e566b6c10ee0809d63.jpg[/img]

🐛 [b]Known & Expected Bugs[/b]
As this is an early work-in-progress build, some issues are known and currently being addressed:

[list]
[*] [b]Unresponsive AI Behavior[/b]
Enemy AI may occasionally fail to react properly. This is often caused by missing information nodes or the inability to find valid cover. We're actively adjusting these systems to strike the right balance between performance and intelligent behavior.

[*] [b]Weapon Rank Display Bug[/b]
In some cases, the in-game weapon rank may appear to reset or decrease after restarting a mission. This is purely a visual issue — your actual progress and weapon stats remain unaffected.

[*] [b]Audio Mixing Incomplete[/b]
The overall sound mix is still under development. Expect placeholder audio, inconsistent volume levels, and general imbalance. This is a key area we’ll be improving over the coming weeks.

[*] [b]Gameplay Lag Spikes[/b]
You may experience minor stutters or lag spikes, particularly when loading new sections of the level. We’re aware of this and working on smoother level streaming and performance optimizations.
[/list]

Please continue to share your experiences — your feedback is critical as we refine the game.

📥 [b]Download the demo now from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/]Steam Store page[/url].[/b]

[b]Wishlist Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam on Steam now: [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/

notes.title: Free Remaster and Content Update now available!
notes.content:
[h2]We're thrilled to announce that the Remastered Edition of Beyond Enemy Lines: Operation Arctic Hawk is now live![/h2] 
This free update brings enhanced visuals, revamped gameplay mechanics, and a host of exciting improvements to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34566421/3bc61daeeb7e71504a57aa4aacfad286fe6c12a2.jpg[/img]

[b]New Singleplayer Missions:[/b]
In addition to the classic story campaign, we've added four singleplayer missions from Beyond Enemy Lines - Remastered Edition to the Remastered Edition. Test your skills and tactical prowess in these thrilling new scenarios as you continue your journey far beyond enemy lines.

[b]Legacy Version Still Available:[/b]
For those who wish to revisit the original experience, the old version of Beyond Enemy Lines: Operation Arctic Hawk is still accessible in the Legacy Beta Branch. You can switch to it from the game's properties menu on Steam.

notes.title: The future of United Assault, Beyond Enemy Lines and survey evaluation
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is the day we look into the future of United Assault, Beyond Enemy Lines and evaluate the latest 'Next Game' survey. There is a lot of new stuff coming in 2022 to play. Lets get started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/c5101b517df9d38ab2768fdeb42f05a1d48b1c11.png[/img]

United Assault - Normandy'44 is a massive success for Polygon Art and the quickest selling game we ever build! I have big planes for United assault and here is what's coming next:

I'm very Happy to announce:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/2f3fc03bb5404f14332e455c98b4db2c0d5a595a.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625340/United_Assault__Battle_of_the_Bulge/

[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/2e1034806bc63a5d27dcdf98b543c419a5f681d5.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/2e1034806bc63a5d27dcdf98b543c419a5f681d5.png[/img][/url]
[i]Click for full screen view[/i]

[b]United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is a standalone expansion to United Assault - Normandy'44 and an open world rogue lite FPS set in 1944's depiction of Ardennes.[/b]

As a british paratromy you are assigned to a mission, few would qualify for. You are tasked to infiltrate enemy territory and locate, infiltrate and destroy one of germany's secret V2 factories in the Ardennes. You'll come along heavy enemy resistance, try to weaken their defense by destroying their tanks, equipment and by gathering secret documents.

[previewyoutube=S_a8nc8H4cY;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625340/United_Assault__Battle_of_the_Bulge/][b]ADD UNITED ASSAULT - BATTLE OF THE BULGE TO YOUR WISHLIST![/b][/url]

[h2][b]What is new?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Playing as a british paratrooper and deploying on a parachute into the game.
[*] Authentic british World War 2 weapons
[*] Larger and more detailed towns and cities
[*] Drivable vehicles scattered around the gameworld
[*] The story is now directly integrated into the main gamemode
[*] Procedural generated underground bunkers complexes (like dungeons)
[/list]
[h2][b]What does this mean for United Assault - Normandy'44?[/b][/h2]
More updates, features and improvements! I'm not going to abandon United Assault - Normandy'44!
Both games are build with the same code base and allows me to patch new features and improvements from Battle of the Bulge back into Normandy '44. All gameplay, gunplay and AI improvements will find it's way into Normandy'44 as well as several new weapons! If you don't want Battle of the Bulge, you still benefit from its development and get regular news updates.

[h2][b]Looking even more into the future?[/b][/h2]
I plann to expand United Assault with 2 additional standalone expansions in the same form as Battle of the Bulge. Those are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/ae32e4afe7704d986384170c41ebe27b778eea33.png[/img]

[h3][b]United Assault Social Media[/b][/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/MZkDwCRb2b]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/UnitedAssaultGame]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/PolygonArt]Twitter[/url]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/15b7e0fa8f8d38a78129449176be71e2e8553061.png[/img]

Beyond Enemy Lines is returning in 2022 with a major update to Beyond Enemy Lines 2 and an entirly new game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/584c45f38fd991d528811c488f36cc7c9fe7d853.png[/img]

[b]Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is getting a free update to a Enhanced Edition![/b]

This update will bring new content, improved game- and gunplay, enhanced visuals and major performance improvements. The before canceled DLC Beyond Enemy Lines 2 - Origins will be added for free to the game.

[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/a4ddd5b37e76e9f9e94ee85fe87e58beacd3412c.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/a4ddd5b37e76e9f9e94ee85fe87e58beacd3412c.png[/img][/url]
[i]Click for full screen view[/i]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] A new, fully voiced 8 mission long campaign of the reimagined Beyond Enemy Lines 1 Story
[*] All other DLC contents will be free for all owners of the base game
[*] The price will increase from 24.99€ to 29.99€ to get in line with the Console versions
[*] Improved update pipeline for faster updates in the future
[*] Contails all map and mission improvements of the console version
[/list]

The Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Enhanced Edition will be released early 2022 for free to all owners of the game on PC and Xbox One with additional native Xbox Series S|X support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/6966d5659cc0311781b25c7c344be9a592db23cf.png[/img]

[b]Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is the newest entry in the Beyond Enemy Lines franchise hitting Steam Early Access in Summer 2022![/b]

Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is a modern warfare shooter set in the Quang-Xiong Island, an autonomous island in the east chinese sea.
The island is of great military importance and the source of numerous conflicts. Whoever hasmilitary control over this territory, is in close range to attack china, taiwan, japan, as well as south and north korea.

Satellite intel reports a lot of recent activity on this island and satellite fotos indicate chinese forces occupied the island. China denies this information and confirms that it has not sent any troops to the region. We cannot verify the credibility of the statement, nor can we verify the identity of the occupiers.

We need to get to the bottom of this mess. You need to be careful - we don’t want a major international incident out of this.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Powered by Unreal Engine 5 with Lumen Global Illumination and Reflections
[*] Command your own Squad
[*] Modern arsenal of highly detailed weapons
[*] Large, complex missions with full tactical freedom
[*] Mid mission checkpoints
[/list]
Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is smaller game in scope then Beyond Enemy Lines 2. We target a story set on 3-4 Missions, each lasting for ~60 minutes. We want to test out new stuff with this game, like a own AI controlled squad you can gve orders to and dip our toe into releasing a game with a new Engine - Unreal Engine 5. Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is building the foundation for Beyond Enemy Lines 3 ...

[url=https://discord.gg/jmz65Vj]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/BeyondEnemyLines]Facebook[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png[/img]



[h1]The Next Game Survey[/h1]
I asked on Social Media, Steam and other platforms what you want to see in the future. Here is the evaluation of this survey with 983 participants at the time of evaluation.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/372f6b1145d749d7be1ff85a1944249cf9d2f850.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/a55a14097947f434cbdb08bf9519e1938dcf885a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/2447647b3d1695dd93b9b7374666fb07b3b84133.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/3b9c88bc125a152404dd5c824fb9b1d5f9020c6b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/f295b4800ec5564fb6cfe3b549f555971849e439.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/73241b9e800edc4dcc436a2e0d78879e236e4bea.png[/img][/url]
[i]Click for full screen view[/i]

The majority of you ([b]60%[/b]) want to see a new [b]Singleplayer[/b] game developed. The diversity in genres you want to see us develop was a majot supprise. [b]FPS[/b] games are by far ([b]35%[/b]) the most requested games, as we develop mostly FPS games this is no big surprise. Followed by this are Simulation (14%) and Role Playing (13%) and Third Person Shooter and Action Adventire (12%).

Beyond Enemy Lines - The Role Playing experience? How would this sound to you? We will continue to focus on FPS games but will definitly consider developing smaller games in the other genres in the future.

We also asked which game you would like to see next. [b]35%[/b] of you want to see a [b]new franchise[/b], 28% a new Beyond Enemy Lines and as United Assault is still a very fresh game it already gathered a respectful 23%.  As both Beyond Enemy Lines and United Assault got new content and games revealed in this news, let's jump to the new franchise ...

[b]The new franchise[/b]

We asked for suggestions which game you would like to see. And apparently you have a very clear goal in mind for us. You want to see from us in the future:

A Singleplayer FPS with focus on Story, more linear gameplay with occasionally larger areas with more freedom. The games you mentioned where shocklingly simmilar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/a9576a3afae61bffbde29c63d3713909bed5b128.png[/img]
You frequently Menitioned Golden Eye and other 007 games as well as No One Lives Forever.

We will follow your wishes and start concepting a new James Bond/No One Lives Forever like franchise together with you in 2022. More on this will follow next year!

notes.title: Server, Security and Anti-Cheat
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dedicated Server[/b][/h1]
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 will launch with a Multiplayer and so servers are a big topic. You want a quick match with a friend? Just host a Peer-2-Peer (P2P) session from ingame and your friends can join. You want to run a 24/7 Server, then a dedicated server is the best way for you.

Dedicated Server Files are included and you can either start them from within your Beyond Enemy Lines 2 installation with the DedicatedServer.exe or the Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Dedicated Server Tool available in the Tools section or for download with SteamCMD. Dedicated Server files are currently only available for Windows.

Launching the DedicatedServer.exe will open this window:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/79a4a9b13187029633cfd740f7f35eacb08e3751.jpg[/img]

This window let you setup your server. By pressing "LAUNCH SERVER" your settings will be saved and the server will be started. Starting the DedicatedServer.exe will reload your last saved settings. Changing the gamemode will result in reseting the core options to the gamemode default settings. 

[u][b]Server Stats:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Default Tick Rate 60hz
[*] Default Port 7777
[/list]

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]: We had on some systems the issue that opening the Port 7777 was not enought to get the Server registrated on the Steam Master Server. A workaround would be to forward the entire Server.exe trough your firewall. Definitly not an ideal situation but a workaround. The Server.exe to forward is located in this folder:
[i]...\Steam\steamapps\common\Beyond Enemy Lines 2\BeyondEnemyLines2\Binaries\Win64\BeyondEnemyLines2Server.exe[/i]


The Server Manager opens by clicking Server Manager in the Dedicated Server Launcher and will open up this window:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/18dc2ab328f385a9adf84b45b6ace57d9098bc7c.jpg[/img]
This window let you communicated with your gameserver and is until ingame RCON is fully implemented the only way to interact with your server except of shutting it down.

[u]Update Player List[/u]
This will fill the list of players on the right sight of the window with checkboxes for each player.

[u]Kick/Ban Player[/u]
All selected players in the Player List will be either kicked or banned.

[u]End Match[/u]
Will end the current match and the server will switch to the next map.

[u]Server Message[/u]
Will print a message with the sender Admin to the ingame text chat.

Warning: If you execute a new command before the last one was executed, you will overwrite the commands. You can not stack the commands.

Each time you press EXECUTE COMMAND, the tool will request the selected options from the server. As the Server is checking every 60 seconds for new commands, it could take up to 60 seconds until you see the result.

[h1][b]Anti-Cheat[/b][/h1]
[u]VAC[/u]
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 utilizes VAC to detect cheats and hacks in the game as well as Gameban those players.

[u]Anti-Memory Injection[/u]
All important variables are protected against Memory Injection and the game checks for memory injection tools and will crash once such a tool is running.

[u]Server Sided Variables[/u]
All the important variables which are also projected against memory injection are running on the server. Weapon Handling is entire server sided and only result in actions visible to the server. Beyond Enemy Lines 2 does not deal damage on the client side and let the sever confirm this. Here the server gets a request to shoot a weapon from the client and the server checks the players current location, fires the weapon and broadcasts the result.

[u]Global Ban List[/u]
On each Map change, every Server (Dedicated or P2P trough ingame hosting) will fetch a Polygon Art Ban list. This Ban List contains SteamIDs of players with a game ban. Once a Player joins a server, it's Steam ID gets validated. If invalid the player gets kicked instantly. With each update after the release, the then current ban list will be updated and hard coded in the game as a backup, if the online ban list was not successfully fetched.
[b]Warning:[/b] Not only cheating and hacking will result in a game ban. Toxic, racist or other inappropriate behavior ingame or in this community can result in a game ban!

[u]Active Admin + Local Ban List[/u]
Server Admins can activly kick and ban players from their server. Server Bans will result in a Local Ban List which works exactly like the Global Ban List but only for this server. This Local Ban List works for Dedicated and Player Hosted P2P Servers.

notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines 2 | Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/65e18ef5587925321f1f2611a9b26f64629712b4.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Release Date[/b][/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-C_OpnAmWHE
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 will launch [b]08.08.2019[/b] on Steam featuring [b]2[/b] Story [b]Campaigns[/b], [b]8 unique[/b] (13 in total) [b]Multiplayer Maps across 3 Gamemodes[/b].

[h1][b]Launch Price[/b][/h1]
Normal Price: $24.99
Launch Discount: -20%
[b]Launch Price: $19.99[/b]*
*Or your regional equivalent.

As some of you might know from Beyond Enemy Lines 1, Polygon Art does not join the massive discount sales. This will be the best price you'll get for a long time!

[h1][b]Singleplayer[/b][/h1]

[b][u]Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Campaign[/u][/b]
[u]Content:[/u] 7 Missions
[u]Playtime:[/u] ~10h (on first run, depending on skill and playstyle)
[u]Story:[/u] 
At 06:00 hours yesterday morning contact was lost with Abkhazia, an autonomous region south of the Greater Caucasus. Intercepted radio messages talk about heavy military activity. We still don’t know how it stands on the damages and the origin of the of the occupying forces are unknown.Intel is currently not able to provide any sitrep. All satellites in the region are offline and redirecting satelites will take a while. Until then we are blind. And this is where we are coming in: give us some eyes on the ground!


[b][u]Warhead Campaign[/u][/b]
[u]Content:[/u] 1 Mission at Launch (7 additional following until December 2019 as DLC's)
[u]Playtime:[/u] ~1h per Mission (on first run, depending on skill and playstyle)
[u]Story:[/u]
This mission has top priority. Target: Mikhail Volkov. You are to locate him and bring him out for debriefing. Mikhail Volkov is our only link with the heist of the warhead. Mikhail is held at a military tank base. The whole area has excellent air defenced. We have to place you some distance from the target until those defenses are disabled. You will travel to the next goods yard - there you will resource transportation. The whole operation is simple - there are three stages:

1) Acquire transportation assets.
2) Disable air defences
3) Find Mikhail Volkov and safely extract him for debriefing.

A large-scale game mode with up to 32 players fighting for the control of key objectives. The team holding the most objectives is in the lead and will drain the enemies tickets. The team with the most tickets left at the end of a round wins. Kills and objective captures will reward you with money, which can be used to buy new weapons and equipment. There are no predefined classes!

Conquest will support Ground vehicles at launch only. Air vehicles are in development and are added as free post launch content.

notes.title: Multiplayer Stress Test #01 | 05. - 08. July
notes.content:
Welcome Agent,

the first big test event is on the horizon and starting tomorrow!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/a8ce657d7583712bfcbba03670fc4375f5b9b46d.jpg[/img]

[h1][u][b]When?[/b][/u][/h1]
05. July 2019 - 08. July 2019 (exact start and end time will be announced at that day.)

[h1][u][b]How do I join?[/b][/u][/h1]
There will be Steam-Keys spread across the Steam Community Hub, [url=www.facebook.com/BeyondEnemyLines]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/PolygonArt]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/QARpGes]Discord[/url] as well as some handpicked from the recent Alpha Test Signup.

[h1][u][b]Whast part of the Test?[/b][/u][/h1]
There will be one mission (CQ_RecruitCamp) and one Gamemode (Conquest). All Weapons, Bot support and Player Ranks are available.
The Rank does not transist into the final game.

[h1][u][b]Can I stream or upload Gameplay videos?[/b][/u][/h1]
Yes you can, but makre sure to clearly mark this as a Stress Test!

[h1][u][b]Whats about to be tested?[/b][/u][/h1]
The overall game stability, gamebreaking bugs and server performance.
There will be only official EU servers available for this test, we want to test how Servers react to a huge load with high pings.

This is a early stress test, there are a lot features incomplete and some weapons are inbalanced. Expect bugs!

notes.title: Price Reveal & Community Event #01
notes.content:
Welcome Agent,

It's time to brief you about the new Multiplayer Rank, the Launch Price and the first Community Event!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/fc06c82166a7ce08c49581c7f16351b432c01eb9.jpg[/img]

[u][h1][b]Multiplayer Rank[/b][/h1][/u]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/0a4ea0d917c16be02c2756ca37e5f71eb2c328f4.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/6650e60bf00dfa6592639ae8666b65611c78e486.jpg[/img][/url]
Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Multiplayer will support a Rank system with a [b]maximum Rank of 120[/b]. Kills and Mission Objectives across Conquest, Team Deathmatch and Coop will reward you XP points. But be aware, [b]Teamkills will give you negative XP[/b] > you can and will derank if you teamkill!

To reach Rank 120 you need to Score 250.000 XP, wich translates to either
[list]
[*] 250.000 Enemies killed
[*] or 166.667 Headshot Kills
[*] or 25.000 completed Objectives.
[/list]

https://youtu.be/A2IK73fdgz0

[u][h1][b]Soundtrack[/b][/h1][/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829296/aed3c106f350c72470cc6c1ceca671cd0ab7aee3.jpg[/img]
For the first time of a Polygon Art release, the official Soundtrack will be available for purchase. The Soundtrack contains 8 Tracks straight out of the game in .MP3 format.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049990/Beyond_Enemy_Lines_2__Soundtrack/

[u][h1][b]Price[/b][/h1][/u]
In the recent [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/697250/announcements/detail/1607135761923865485]Survey[/url] we asked you about your toughts and opinion about Beyond Enemy Lines 2. We asked you about the Price of the game  and it's features. [b]Over 700 of you have spoken and the results are astonishing.[/b] 

[list]
[*] "We absoluty don't want Battle Royale!" (99% Dislike)
[*] 93% of you Player on PC and one Person on Gamecube ;-)
[*] For over 60% of you large missions and freedom are the most important
[*] You really want to see the Coop Mission Generator in action
[*] Over 60% of you would pay $30 or more for Beyond Enemy Lines 2
[/list]

[u]And this will be the price for Beyond Enemy Lines 2:[/u]
[b]$24.99 / 24.99€[/b] will get you 10+h Singleplayer, PvP Multiplayer and Coop, free Multiplayer updates and no Microtransactions, Loot Boxes or unnecessary unlocks.

[b]But you can lower this price even more ...[/b]

[u][h1][b]Community Event #01[/b][/h1][/u]
From now on, you will define the Launch Discount!

The more people Wishlist Beyond Enemy Lines 2, the higher the Launch Discount and lower the actual price you need to pay!
Share this game with your friends and on Social Media.

Mention [url=www.facebook.com/BeyondEnemyLines]Beyond Enemy Lines 2[/url] in your Facebook posts or [url=https://twitter.com/PolygonArt]Polygon Art[/url] on Twitter to get the chance for special access to the closed Multiplayer Alpha!
